betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Before going further into CropsNH, there is but one chore I need you to do. §6To prevent future hardship, collect a fully statted 31/31/31 seed.§r

This may seem daunting at first, but with enough blood, sweat, fertilizer, and a trusty crop manager, you can do it. I believe in you!

§4Ensure you pick a species which is related via mutation pools and determinism to other Crops you want.§r If you don't know what to choose, may I suggest the any of the natura berries (Raspberry, Blueberry, Blackberry or Maloberry), Cactus, or Brown Mushrooms? 

- The berries have a fairly low growth times which can grow fairly quickly and have access to the Food pool which opens up access to a lot of other useful pools.
- Cactus grants access to the danger pool which can help get started with ore berries.
- Brown Mushrooms can only be grown in the dark (light level of 9 or lower), but grants you access to the Brown and Mushroom pools for Corium and Fertilia.

While there is a reason behind keeping some seeds low statted (lowering enriched fertilizer costs in machines), the time saved by working with max stat crops compared to low stat crops is just too significant to ignore.

§oThis quest will accept any CropsNH seed with a perfect statline.
